# ChatGPT scientific / strategic review — 2026-11-04

Reviewed exact PR HEAD `9320a8a4e33193af613022eb9b900dbddb5fc1c6`, the submitted review, formula register, historical-method audit, model comparison, literature register, site selection, archive-validation report, and PR file list. Cross-checked original 2015 determination in the Federal Register, including visually rendered PDF pages 14 (§17), 17 (§23), and 26 (§35), and the live ARRC consultation page. This is an evidence-bounded scholarly review, **not** independent verification of all 20 formulas, all 10 papers, local test reruns, facility emissions, or legal advice.

## Dispositions
- **ACCEPT (scoped):** F2015L00060 is no longer in force; official register says 19 Jan 2015–31 Mar 2025. Evidence: https://www.legislation.gov.au/Series/F2015L00060
- **ACCEPT:** Eq1 belongs to §17, `A_N=A_0+A_Acc`; corrected P0 citation. Evidence: official original PDF, printed p.10 / PDF p.14.
- **ACCEPT:** Eq4 §23 uses explicit `F_C→CH4=1.336` and location-specific historical statutory `W_LFG` table (not measured present-day collection). Official original PDF, printed p.13 / PDF p.17.
- **ACCEPT:** Eq16 §35 `CE=0.98` is *biogas collection efficiency*, not destruction efficiency. Official original PDF, printed p.22 / PDF p.26.
- **ACCEPT WITH LIMITS:** The 20 reviewed AWT2015 formula transcriptions do not add a free ambient-temperature, altitude, rainfall, or Q10 coefficient. This does NOT prove that broader statutory cross-references have no climate-sensitive parameters. Keep scientific kinetics separate from historical legal accounting.
- **REVISE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE:** All 20 formulas' independent fidelity and operative context remain unverified, especially §8 external version timing, §31 electricity factor relevant day, §19–20 crediting exceptions, §39–41 legacy, missing data §43–46. Do not certify runnable legal method.
- **ACCEPT WITH LIMITS:** Scientific literature supports process hypotheses and contrasts generation / oxidation / capture / combustion / emitted flux / credited tCO2e. However CLEEN2015 and pond2014 remain ABSTRACT_ONLY; certain papers are partial and site transfer requires actual process calibration. No one-to-one transfer of lab Q10 or wetland parameters to landfill or lagoon.
- **REVISE:** Cooma and Rockhampton station climate normals use different observation windows; station coordinates are not plant locations and air temperature is not landfill-core or lagoon-water temperature. No matched operational/flux dataset; not a causal cross-region comparison.
- **INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE:** Independent real-world emission forecasting, final compliance, ACCU eligibility, independent physical validation, and all original local QA logs have not been fully reproduced by this reviewer.

Primary links: https://www.legislation.gov.au/F2015L00060/asmade/2015-01-19/text/original/pdf and https://ausrrc.com.au/awt-remake/ (consultation closes 29 Nov 2026 23:59 AEST; not operative law).

## Review outcome
**Accept Batch A as a bounded research archive / review-ready milestone. Science admission PENDING. Preserve Draft PR #132; do not merge, deploy, create calculator, or run emission experiments. No GitHub commit statuses or PR-triggered workflow runs were returned for HEAD, therefore no CI PASS claim.**

## Next narrow batch
Proceed only with **Batch B: official-source catalogue of Australian landfill, organics-processing, transfer/recycling, wastewater and lagoon facilities**, covering Commonwealth and all states/territories. Record source identity, licence, reporting period, type, site ID, coordinates/precision, operational status, throughput availability, methane recovery/control availability, deduplication, coverage and uncertainty. A/B/C tiers must measure *data availability*, not assurance. Reject unsupported national facility count / national emissions extrapolation. Keep raw data permission and private Council boundaries intact.

Prepare Batch C extreme-climate/multi-gas protocol as a **proposal** after Batch B source coverage review; no coupled numerical model or scientific experiment without separate Founder authorization. Maintain linked `NEXT_SESSION.md`, SHA receipt and Slides-style offline review.

CRP: knowledge—legally specified accounting differs from physical gas flux; idea—official nationwide asset geography before model; decision—Batch A conditionally accepted, B evidence inventory approved for research only; open—independent formula transcription, external reporting-year factors, site activity data; next—bounded B source register; keywords—ClimateOS/CarbonOS/AWT/ACCU/MRV/landfill/lagoon/CH4/N2O/ENSO.
